title: The logarithmic generalised Kummer locus and its tropicalisation
summary: We construct a separated logarithmic compactification of a divisor in the moduli of polarised irreducible holomorphic symplectic (IHS) varieties of generalised Kummer type in dimension at least four. This compactification carries a universal family of logarithmic IHS varieties, and its tropicalisation carries a universal family of tropical generalised Kummer varieties.
